FEIXIAOMOD-YASAKA_FUMO_RELIC.description: Adds 1 [gold]Wife Plush Power[/gold] to your deck.
FEIXIAOMOD-YASAKA_FUMO_RELIC.flavor: I miss my wife, Player, I miss her a lot.
FEIXIAOMOD-YASAKA_FUMO_RELIC.title: Golden Foxian Plush
FEIXIAOMOD-AXE_RELIC.flavor: Ah, I still [i][b]remember[/b][/i] the first time I used this very axe, it was to defend my [i][b]brood~[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-AXE_RELIC.title: Mother's Axe
FEIXIAOMOD-MILK_BOTTLE_RELIC.flavor: I get so full you know? [i][b]Gotta get rid of the pressure somehow~[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-MILK_BOTTLE_RELIC.title: Fresh Milk Bottle
FEIXIAOMOD-OFFERING_PLATE_RELIC.descript: Enchants any [gold]Attack Card[/gold] with the [purple]Offering Marker[/purple] [gold]Enchant[/gold].
FEIXIAOMOD-OFFERING_PLATE_RELIC.flavor: Oh my? You wish to offer your prey to me? [i][b]I'll gladly indulge every bite.[b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-OFFERING_PLATE_RELIC.title: Empty Offering Plate
FEIXIAOMOD-PREYS_SKULL_RELIC.description: Enchants all [gold]Skill[/gold] cards with the [purple]Baleful Burden[/purple] [gold]Enchant[/gold].
FEIXIAOMOD-PREYS_SKULL_RELIC.flavor: Ah, this one, I remember him, tried to get to me through my kids. [i][b]Didn't end well for him.[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-PREYS_SKULL_RELIC.title: Old Skull
FEIXIAOMOD-SWADDLING_CLOTH_RELIC.flavor: Ah, keep this on you for me, would you? I rather you come back in one piece so I can eat you [i][b]whole[/b][/i] myself.
FEIXIAOMOD-SWADDLING_CLOTH_RELIC.title: Swaddling Cloth
FEIXIAOMOD-WIND_PUPPER_PLUSH_RELIC.descr:
At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
FEIXIAOMOD-WIND_PUPPER_PLUSH_RELIC.flavo: Yes, my [i][b]Flying Aureus[/b][/i] plush, my first bit of handmade work I put together and gave to one of my kids~
FEIXIAOMOD-WIND_PUPPER_PLUSH_RELIC.title: Aureus Plush
FEIXIAOMOD-WOMB_TATTOO_RELIC.description: Enchants all [gold]Strike[/gold] cards with the [purple]Hunters Rune[/purple] [gold]Enchant[/gold].
FEIXIAOMOD-WOMB_TATTOO_RELIC.flavor: This little thing? Be glad I don't brand you with it myself~ [i][b]It was given to me by someone very special to me.[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-WOMB_TATTOO_RELIC.title: Rune of The Hunt
FEIXIAOMOD-MEDIC_FAN_RELIC.description: Enchants any [gold]Attack Card[/gold] with the [purple]Medicinal Scent[/purple] [gold]Enchant[/gold].
FEIXIAOMOD-MEDIC_FAN_RELIC.flavor: Oh this old thing? My personal physician used to use it. I hope it helps you on your journey~
FEIXIAOMOD-MEDIC_FAN_RELIC.title: Hand Held Fan
FEIXIAOMOD-TOUCH_FLUFFY_TAIL_RELIC.descr: Enchants any [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] card with the [purple]Lucky Tail[/purple] [gold]Enchant[/gold]
FEIXIAOMOD-TOUCH_FLUFFY_TAIL_RELIC.flavo: A little luck goes a long way, yes? [i][b]Foxes are signs of good luck, intelligence and adaptability after all~[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-TOUCH_FLUFFY_TAIL_RELIC.title: Fox Tail
FEIXIAOMOD-GOLD_KUNOU_RELIC.flavor: Ah yes, this was my first child, well... Technically she's a step daughter, but I remade her into my own child eventually.
FEIXIAOMOD-GOLD_KUNOU_RELIC.title: Golden Child Idol
FEIXIAOMOD-FANGED_GRIN_RELIC.flavor: Merely call upon my name in battle, and feed me tribute Child.
FEIXIAOMOD-FANGED_GRIN_RELIC.title: Feixiao's Mad Grin
